text: Security is a crucial part of web development that every developer should understand. First, always use HTTPS to encrypt data between users and servers, protecting sensitive information from attackers. Second, implement strong authentication methods, such as complex passwords and two-factor authentication, to ensure only authorized users can access accounts. Third, validate all user input carefully to prevent malicious code from entering your system. Finally, be aware of common vulnerabilities like SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which remain major threats. By following these practices, developers can build safer websites and protect both their users and their data from potential attacks.
